rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an edge, a location or relative side, a family side, or an informal group taking one side.

example.english: This time, we are on the home team's side.
example.traditional: 今次比賽我哋企喺主隊嗰邊。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ngo5 dei6 kei5 hai2 zyu2 deoi6 go2 bin1

rows.note: Use this for the side-facing surface of a three-dimensional object or for a side area viewed in relation to something.

example.english: There is a scratch on the side of this chair.
example.traditional: 呢張櫈嘅側面有條刮痕。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 dang3 ge3 zak1 min6 jau5 tiu4 gwaat3 han4

rows.note: Use this for a numbered page or sheet side, especially when counting how many pages an essay has.

example.english: My essay is five pages long, counting each side.
example.traditional: 我篇文有五頁，計埋每一面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 pin1 man4 jau5 ng5 jip6 gai3 maai4 mui5 jat1 min6

rows.note: Use this for one aspect or feature of a matter, person, or thing, as in considering its positive side.

example.english: On the benefits side, this job is pretty good too.
example.traditional: 呢份工人工高，福利方面都唔錯。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 jan4 gung1 gou1 fuk1 lei6 fong1 min6 dou1 m4 co3
